Name: Harvard University
Notes: Ivy School, World Famous, Highly Selective. Notable alumni include U.S. presidents and Nobel laureates; strong in law, business, and medicine.

Name: Stanford University
Notes: Known for innovation, entrepreneurship, and proximity to Silicon Valley. Alumni include tech founders and Nobel laureates.

Name: University of Oxford
Notes: Oldest university in the English-speaking world. Collegiate system; strong in humanities, sciences, politics.

Name: University of Cambridge
Notes: Noted for historic colleges, discoveries in science, mathematics, literature. Alumni include many Nobel Prize winners.

Name: Massachusetts Institute of Technology
Notes: Leader in engineering, technology, and science. Famous for its culture of innovation, robotics, and entrepreneurship.

Name: University of Tokyo
Notes: Top university in Japan, research intensive, strong in science, law, and engineering. Alumni include many prime ministers.

Name: ETH Zurich
Notes: Renowned for engineering, architecture, and natural sciences. High international student population.

Name: University of Melbourne
Notes: One of Australia's leading universities, strong in medicine, law, and the arts. Culturally diverse campus.

Name: Peking University
Notes: China's oldest national university, prestigious for research in sciences, humanities, and social sciences.

Name: Sorbonne University
Notes: Result of merger; famous heritage in arts, sciences, medicine. Central to French intellectual life for centuries.
